merchant_description: Shilucheng Bamboo Sheets 60% bamboo and 40% polyester fiber  Deep pockets fit mattresses up to 16"
Affordable Luxury

This set offers the pinnacle of modern luxury bedding at an affordable price. 14" Deep Pocket with great elasticity, Stretches to Fit Mattresses Up to 16" Thick. The sheets grip and fit better than any other set, ensuring no sliding during sleep. Enjoy a restful night's sleep with these sheets.
Shockingly Soft & Silky

Made from 60% rayon derived from bamboo and 40% polyester fiber, with a unique twill weave. It's stronger than cotton, smooth like silk, and cool to the touch. Sleep like you're on a cloud. Ideal for hot sleepers, these sheets provide comfort and coolness.
️ Adjust Temperature & Absorb Water ️
The sheets adjust temperature and absorb most of the heat, keeping you cool in summer. They also absorb moisture, keeping you dry and eliminating bad sleep experiences for those with night sweats.
Easy Care & Durability
Durable and machine washable, these sheets are easy to care for. Wash in cold water on a gentle cycle. Dry at low temperatures. Avoid using fabric softeners and bleaches to prevent wrinkles.

merchant_description: BAMBOO SHEETS - Crafted from bamboo, these all-natural luxury sheets provide a much longer life span than bamboo blend sheets, microfiber, or cotton sheets. Bamboo sheets have a history of retaining their softness for years of cozy comfort.

SUPER COOLING BAMBOO SHEETS - Bamboo sheets will keep you comfortable and cool all night long. Bamboo sheets are great if you’re a hot sleeper, suffer from night sweats, or have hot flashes because of their breathability.

DEEP POCKET SHEETS - Many mattresses are quite deep these days and those mattresses require sheets with deep pockets to match. Bamboo sheets are a perfect complement for these mattresses due to the fabric’s flexibility. Our bamboo sheets fit mattresses up to 16 inches deep and still fit great on mattresses less than 16 inches.

SUPER SOFT & LIGHTWEIGHT - These luxury bamboo bed sheets are light, breathable, and silky soft. Soft and cooling bamboo sheets provide a luxurious night’s sleep. Instead of being a bamboo blend with heavy fabrics such as cotton, microfiber, or even worse polyester these soft bamboo sheets are made from high-quality natural bamboo fibers.

MOISTURE WICKING SHEETS - Bamboo sheets are great moisture-wicking sheets because bamboo fabrics are hygroscopic, meaning they absorb moisture and move it away from your body. This quality lends to the comfort and breathability of bamboo sheets. The moisture-wicking properties of these soft bamboo sheets deliver a dry, fresh, and friendly night’s sleep.
